title: After the Japanese Derby: No Plan is the Best Plan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer gives it her all in the Japanese Derby. She manages to push her way to the front just before the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her rivals compliment her performance and some people in the crowd begin to chant her name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night, after reviewing the day's race, Daitaku Helios seems to have come up with some kind of "god-tier" race plan.
